up: Retrieve activity rows where the assay targets human single-protein CHEMBL2146302 (glutaminase kidney isoform, mitochondrial), the activity type is IC50 with exact standard relation '=', the standard value is non-null, and the pChEMBL value is non-null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type (IC50), pChEMBL value. Order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id. Return up to 1000 rows.
sql: WITH target_activities AS (SELECT a.activity_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value, a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_relation, a.value AS standard_value, a.units AS standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2146302' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN') SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, ta.standard_type, ta.pchembl_value FROM target_activities ta JOIN activities a ON ta.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
